title: Statement Timetable and Resource-Limit Notice Figures: Resident Trust Fund Accounts
content:
Every Resident Trust Fund Accounts tier receives the same statement timetable; the resource-limit notice applies to the Medicaid tiers only.

## Statements (all six tiers)

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Frequency | quarterly, one statement per calendar quarter |
| Issued within | 15 calendar days after the quarter ends |
| Statement asked for between quarters | provided within 2 business days |
| Recipients | the resident and the representative |

## Resource-limit notice

| Tier | Notice applies | SSI resource limit measured against | Notice margin below the limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Self-Directed | Yes | $2000.00 | $200.00 |
| Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Representative Payee | Yes | $2000.00 | $200.00 |
| Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Guardianship | Yes | $2000.00 | $200.00 |
| Resident Funds Account, Non-Medicaid Self-Directed | No | $2000.00 | $200.00 |
| Resident Funds Account, Non-Medicaid Representative Payee | No | $2000.00 | $200.00 |
| Resident Funds Account, Non-Medicaid Guardianship | No | $2000.00 | $200.00 |

The notice level is the SSI resource limit less the notice margin: $2000.00 less $200.00, that is $1800.00.

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

- The quarter ending 30 September issues its statement no later than 15 October.
- A statement requested on a Tuesday with no bank holiday that week is provided by Thursday, within 2 business days.
